verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs say it sets up 'a whole host of development environments' from the Install > Development menu. They name Ruby on Rails, Laravel and Node.js, with Mise managing language versions per project, which directly covers quick setup of framework and language environments. Missing for 10: a complete list of the supported frameworks and languages, details on what preconfiguration each installer actually applies, and independent hands-on corroboration of the dev-environment installers specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can quickly set up preconfigured development environments for popular frameworks and languages

citations.quote: Omarchy supports setting up a whole host of development environments through the _Install > Development_ section of the Omarchy Menu
Install Ruby on Rails, Laravel, Node.js, and a long list of other development environments from the Omarchy menu. Mise handles language versions, so each project can use what it needs.
